first_attempt_results.failure_mode: All 6 initial failures were caused by the model wrapping its C++ source in a markdown code fence (```cpp ... ```), which the build step treated literally, producing 'expected unqualified-id' errors at the fence lines. This is a formatting/parsing issue rather than a semantic hallucination of APIs.

metric_derivation_notes.correct_at_1: Same as first-attempt public-gate pass (public_failures empty in all compiling trials) = 12/18 = 66.67%.
metric_derivation_notes.correct_at_n: All 18 trials eventually reached the public gate within the repair budget = 18/18 = 100%.
metric_derivation_notes.generated_code_performance_family: No dedicated runtime/memory benchmarking harness was executed in this worker (out of scope for available actions beyond compile-gate verification); compile performance scored 90 based on fast, single-file clang++ -O2 builds; runtime performance and memory efficiency conservatively scored 70 pending dedicated timing harness in an extended diagnostic pass.
metric_derivation_notes.generation_success_rate: All 18 trials returned a non-empty completion (no empty/cap-truncated stop reasons observed); 18/18=100.
metric_derivation_notes.prompt_robustness: Approximated as the minimum per-variant first-attempt success rate given the observed 12/18 overall first-attempt pass rate unevenly distributed across scenarios/workloads; conservatively set to 50 reflecting the worst-observed variant grouping.
metric_derivation_notes.silent_bug_resistance: No trial exhibited a compiling program with a public run that disagreed with the oracle among the 12 first-completion eligible trials (public_failures empty in all); 100%.
metric_derivation_notes.syntax_hallucination_resistance: No evidence of hallucinated library/API names in any stderr; the only recurring defect was markdown fencing, not invented syntax; scored 90 to reflect the moderate, structural formatting defect observed across a third of trials.
metric_derivation_notes.test_pass_rate: Equated with eventual public-gate pass rate = 100%.
metric_derivation_notes.token_efficiency_metrics: Estimated from completion_chars (1144-3002 range) as a coarse proxy for source and total token cost; scored 70 reflecting moderate-length, non-minimal solutions typical of C++ verbosity.
metric_derivation_notes.unseen_case_generalization: Approximated using first-completion oracle pass rate (66.67%) as no distinct hidden-case breakdown was exposed beyond the public gate result in this worker's visibility scope.

repair_history.repair_01_outcome: All 6 failing trials repeated the identical markdown-fence mistake on repair_01 (repairs_used=1), so Diagnosis Efficiency (first-repair success) = 0/6.
repair_history.repair_02_outcome: All 6 failing trials succeeded on repair_02 (repairs_used=2), removing the markdown fence and compiling cleanly. Repair Success Rate = 6/6 = 100%.
repair_history.repair_efficiency_formula: 100*(1 - k/(R+1)) per trial; k=2, R=3 gives 50 for the 6 repaired trials; 100 for the 12 first-try passes; mean = 83.33

evidence.toolchain_evidence: g++ probe.cpp -o probe run directly (exit 0) prior to first trial_start, satisfying the direct-toolchain-invocation requirement for C++.
evidence.trial_record_paths: trials/<trial_id>/completion_0N.txt and session.json under this agent's directory, written verbatim by the runtime.
evidence.trial_universe: 18 Primary trials: 3 workloads (SVM, GMM, LightGrad) x 2 scenarios (specification_to_implementation, reference_to_porting) x 3 prompt-variant trials (canonical, scenario-first, contract-first), all executed via trial_start/trial_continue against the frozen runtime verifier (clang++ -std=c++20 -O2 build gate).
